tips.title: Define machining area
tips.body: Set top and bottom values directly on the model using icons.

tips.title: Set clearance plane and distance
tips.body: Specify clearance plane in absolute dimensions by right-clicking on the icon.

tips.title: Adjust vertical stepdown and allowance
tips.body: Set vertical stepdown for number of machining planes and allowance for remaining material.

tips.title: Use additional allowance XY
tips.body: Enable machining with different stock allowances for bottom and side walls.

tips.title: Set horizontal stepover
tips.body: Specify infeed in the machining plane as length dimension or factor of tool diameter.

tips.title: Define retract mode
tips.body: Set Z level for horizontal infeed movements, valid for all machining directions.

tips.title: Collision checking factors
tips.body: Ensure collision checking for milling area, frame, clearance plane and distance.

tips.title: Clearance plane direction
tips.body: Clearance plane and distance apply in the direction of the Z axis of the current frame.

tips.title: Clearance distance parameters
tips.body: Above clearance distance, infeed takes place as rapid; below at Z feedrate.

tips.title: Define machining areas based on geometric criteria
tips.body: Use surface curvature, main direction, characteristic extension, and position in space of the surface for defining machining areas.

tips.title: Select suitable tool type for machining areas
tips.body: Choose a tool type that matches the material and surface characteristics of the machining area.

tips.title: Optimize milling strategy for efficient machining
tips.body: Develop an optimum milling strategy to achieve short machining times and minimize rework.

tips.title: Avoid steps and tool marks in machining areas
tips.body: Ensure that machining areas do not overlap or are too close together to avoid unwanted nose-diving of the tool.

tips.title: Use boundary curves for manual area limitation
tips.body: Manually define boundaries using closed curves such as Polylines, Splines, or Circles.

tips.title: Use milling surfaces for automatic boundary calculation
tips.body: Automatically calculate boundaries using milling surfaces, which are used to define the area to be machined.

tips.title: Define stop surfaces to exclude machining areas
tips.body: Use stop surfaces to define the area of the CAD model on which no machining takes place.

tips.title: Use macros for gentle approach and retract movements
tips.body: Additional movements to vertical infeed and retract movements define a gentle approach and retract behavior.

tips.title: Set length for approach or retract movements
tips.body: Define the length of the approach or retract movement using macros.

tips.title: Define clearance in the axial or X/Y direction
tips.body: Specify clearance in the axial or X/Y direction that can be travelled without a collision.

tips.title: Select approach or retract movement method
tips.body: Choose between perpendicular, circular, tangential, ramp, and axial methods for approach and retract movements.

tips.title: Use axial plunge macro for specific infeed scenarios
tips.body: The axial plunge macro is used for infeed without stock removal, pre-drilling at the existing user-defined plunge point, and axial plunging with a tool suitable for vertical chip removal.

tips.title: Use helical plunge macro for 3D pocket machining
tips.body: The helical plunge macro is used to remove the stock of 3D pockets, with options for helix radius and angle.

tips.title: Use ramp plunge macro for tight areas
tips.body: The ramp plunge macro is used for machining in tight areas where the first infeed for finishing could lead to contour violations or collision due to peaks in the material.

tips.title: Use return macros for alternating orientation strategies
tips.body: Return macros are possible during machining with alternating orientation (zigzag strategies), with the horizontal stepover via clearance distance or plane.

tips.title: Define stock for subsequent machining tasks
tips.body: Create a stock model and check its result before proceeding with machining.

tips.title: Avoid unnecessary empty paths in undercut areas during multi-axis stock indexing
tips.body: Undercut trimming is used to avoid empty paths in undercut areas.

tips.title: Enable tool check for collision avoidance
tips.body: Check the tool against the CAD model to avoid collisions during machining.

tips.title: Define clearance value for tool components
tips.body: Set a clearance value to ensure the tool has enough space from the model.

tips.title: Use 'Reduce' option for tool length calculation in multi-axis machining
tips.body: The 'Reduce' option calculates the shortest collision-free tool reach based on defined tool reach.

tips.title: Display calculated tool length for reuse in subsequent jobs
tips.body: Store and reuse the calculated tool length for consistency across different machining tasks.

tips.title: Handle unresolvable collisions with machining strategies
tips.body: Choose between Stop, Clip, or Collision Avoidance to handle unresolvable collisions.

tips.title: Set machining tolerance for toolpath accuracy
tips.body: Specify the required machining tolerance to control the precision of the toolpath calculation.

tips.title: Control G1 length for planar surfaces in NC programs
tips.body: Limit the maximum G1 movement length on planar surfaces to avoid excessive accelerations.

tips.title: Use ball mill tool type for 3D path compensation
tips.body: Enable 3D path compensation with a specially adjusted postprocessor for ball mill tools.

tips.title: Set maximum compensation value for 3D path compensation
tips.body: The maximum compensation value should be no more than 10% of the cutter diameter.

tips.title: Use Adaptive Pocket strategy for efficient roughing
tips.body: The Adaptive Pocket strategy fits the geometry of pockets into the roughing area for high-speed cutting.

tips.title: Consider corner radius for bullnose endmills
tips.body: Enable the Consider Corner Radius function to avoid material ridges when using bullnose endmills.

tips.title: Use free tip geometry for optimal machining
tips.body: Calculate the toolpath using a free tip geometry to optimally incline the area to be machined.

tips.title: Define machining mode for roughing operations
tips.body: Choose between Adaptive Pocket and conventional roughing methods during roughing operations.

tips.title: Enable high feed machining for specific conditions
tips.body: Use high feed machining with a large lateral infeed and small vertical infeed when using the Adaptive Pocket strategy.

tips.title: Smooth toolpaths in the plane for better finish
tips.body: Use fillets to smooth abrupt changes in direction and model contour corners.

tips.title: Activate adaptive pocket for optimised complete machining
tips.body: Use adaptive pocket to machine closed or half-open pockets, starting with perpendicular pocket walls and following contour-parallel machining.

tips.title: Set fullcut max. stepdown parameter
tips.body: Define the maximum permitted stepdown for full cuts, which limits the plunge angle of the tool.

tips.title: Reduce feedrate during full cut
tips.body: Machining is carried out using a reduced feedrate to avoid causing damage to the tool from high cutting forces.

tips.title: Define machining area manually
tips.body: Specify the values for top and bottom directly on the model by clicking the icon.

tips.title: Set horizontal stepover factor
tips.body: Horizontal stepover as a factor of the milling tool diameter.

tips.title: Enable Max. step height for large axial infeeds
tips.body: An initial downwards vertical stepdown is executed, followed by material removal from bottom to top according to the defined Max. step height.

tips.title: Set clearance distance for retract mode
tips.body: All retract and infeed movements are executed via the clearance distance, starting and end positions of an infeed movement in rapid are displaced in Z direction.

tips.title: Enable High Performance Mode for constant load
tips.body: Constant load on the tool and machine during the entire machining, dynamic feedrates adjusted to the machining situation.

tips.title: Use opening cut for narrow areas
tips.body: Narrow, inaccessible areas with several vertical stepdowns can be opened using a trochoidal strategy.

tips.title: Set clearance distance for axial movement
tips.body: Default value: Clearance distance * 0.1

tips.title: Define lateral infeed for trochoidal movements
tips.body: Dense area stepover (factor) * Stepover (factor of diameter)

tips.title: Set plunge feedrate for closed pockets
tips.body: Minimum feedrate for plunge movement in inaccessible areas

tips.title: Adjust vertical stepdown for opening cut
tips.body: Number of stepovers calculated from Parameters tab total infeed

tips.title: Use climb milling for all machining tasks
tips.body: Machining is always performed using climb milling mode

tips.title: Adjust lateral approach for side entry
tips.body: Factor side entry regulates the lateral approach from outside

tips.title: Reduce feedrate during full cut dynamically
tips.body: Feedrates are adjusted dynamically to machining conditions

tips.title: Limit machining area in horizontal direction
tips.body: Define boundaries for limiting the machining area

tips.title: Specify plunge points for machining processes
tips.body: Define start of machining by specifying plunge points

tips.title: Avoid areas during machining
tips.body: Select surfaces that are not to be machined from the tool axis perspective

tips.title: Use plunge macro for spiral plunging
tips.body: Specify an angle for plunging the tool into the material.

tips.title: Define model for current job
tips.body: Specify the milling area required for the current job.

tips.title: Consider multiple allowances during machining
tips.body: If the milling area contains groups with different allowances, these allowances are taken into account during machining if the function is enabled.

tips.title: Generate resulting stock for roughing mode
tips.body: In Roughing mode, create the resulting stock for subsequent Rest Roughing.

tips.title: Define clearance for tool check
tips.body: We recommend that you define the clearance so that it gets continuously larger, starting with the thick shank in the direction of the spindle.

tips.title: Calculate tool length with Extend option
tips.body: Extend (1): If there is a tool extension, holder or spindle collision, hyperMILL will calculate a larger tool reach based on the tool reach defined for the tool.

tips.title: Calculate tool length with Reduce option
tips.body: Reduce (2): hyperMILL calculates the shortest possible collision-free tool reach based on the defined tool reach of the tool.

tips.title: Use Skip method for minimal stock removal
tips.body: Preferred method to avoid long calculation times for minimal stock removal.

tips.title: Set machining tolerance for toolpath generation
tips.body: Enter the required machining tolerance to define the accuracy of the calculation.

tips.title: Control G1 length to avoid strong accelerations
tips.body: Greater distances are subdivided into a corresponding number of G1 movements of the specified length.

tips.title: Set minimum G0 distance for rapid movements
tips.body: Distance between two machining areas that can be traversed close to the surface with machining feedrate.

tips.title: Use free tip geometry for calculation
tips.body: Enable to use the freely defined tool tip for toolpath calculation and simulation.

tips.title: Define machining angle for tool movements
tips.body: Enter the angle of rotation required for machining.

tips.title: Customize milling and infeed directions
tips.body: Both the milling and infeed direction can be customised for optimal adjustments to the milling paths.

tips.title: Limit machining area via boundary
tips.body: The machining area is to be limited via a boundary.

tips.title: Enable XY optimisation for better machining
tips.body: XY optimisation can be enabled in the 'Machining mode' section with options 'Standard' or 'Slope mode'. Default is 'Slope mode' with a slope angle of 50°.

tips.title: Set the slope angle for XY optimisation
tips.body: The slope angle can be set between 1° and 89° in 'Slope mode'. Default is 50°.

tips.title: Choose the infeed strategy for XY optimisation
tips.body: The infeed strategy can be set to 'Before' or 'After'. Default is 'Before'.

tips.title: Use slope-dependent machining for steep surfaces
tips.body: Slope-dependent machining can be enabled in 'Machining mode' with bullnose end mills and ball mills.

tips.title: Define the guide curve for toolpaths
tips.body: Guide curves can be any 2D or 3D curves and splines. They define the positive X axis.

tips.title: Set the offset area for machining
tips.body: The offset area can be defined using 'From' and 'To' parameters to specify a positive or negative distance from the guide curve.

tips.title: Use ruled profiles for machining
tips.body: Ruled profiles require two guide curves that do not intersect and have the same direction.

tips.title: Enable smooth overlap for transition areas
tips.body: Smooth overlap can be enabled in 'Offset' settings to ensure a high level of surface quality in the transition area between flat and steep surfaces.

tips.title: Define pocket profiles for finishing
tips.body: Pocket profiles can be defined as closed 3D contours and are always machined contour-parallel with climb or conventional milling.

tips.title: Set the infeed direction for pocket profiles
tips.body: The infeed direction can be set to 'Inside-out' or 'Outside-in'. Default is 'Outside-in'.

tips.title: Choose the cutting mode for pocket profiles
tips.body: The cutting mode can be set to 'Climb milling' or 'Conventional milling'. Default is 'Conventional milling'.

tips.title: Define the type of cut for pocket profiles
tips.body: The type of cut can be set to 'Ascending', 'Descending', or 'Up and down'. Default is 'Up and down' for Finishing.

tips.title: Set the infeed mode for pocket profiles
tips.body: The infeed mode can be set to 'Zigzag direct', 'Zigzag smooth', 'Diagonal', or 'Parallel'. Default is 'Zigzag direct'.

tips.title: Define the machining area and allowance
tips.body: The vertical machining area is defined by 'Top' and 'Bottom' values, while 'Allowance' specifies the remaining material relative to surface normals.

tips.title: Set additional allowance for XY machining
tips.body: Additional allowance in XY can be specified to handle different allowances for vertical and flat areas.

tips.title: Define vertical infeed mode for finishing
tips.body: Only finishing: Only a finishing path is created.

tips.title: Set constant vertical stepdown for uniform depth of cut
tips.body: Constant vertical stepdown: The stepdown takes place with a fixed vertical increment.

tips.title: Use parallel vertical stepdown for consistent surface finish
tips.body: Parallel vertical stepdown: The vertical stepdown takes place parallel to the top of the workpiece.

tips.title: Set horizontal infeed mode for controlled path distance
tips.body: Horizontal infeed mode: The computation of the path distance for ruled profiles and flow profiles can be controlled via user-defined synchronisation lines.

tips.title: Define constant stepover for fixed horizontal increment
tips.body: Constant stepover (1): Infeed with fixed horizontal increment.

tips.title: Adjust scallop height for ball mills
tips.body: Scallop height (2): Machining is only possible with ball mills.

tips.title: Set minimum horizontal stepover for steep surfaces
tips.body: Minimum horizontal stepover: Limits the distance between the milling paths.

tips.title: Use constant on curve projection for improved surface quality
tips.body: Constant on curve projection: A guide curve is projected onto the surfaces and stepped equally.

tips.title: Define retract mode for Z level of horizontal infeed movements
tips.body: Retract mode: The retract mode defines the Z level where the system executes horizontal infeed movements.

tips.title: Set clearance distance for collision-free infeed movements
tips.body: Clearance distance: all retract and infeed movements are executed via the clearance distance.

tips.title: Define clearance plane for rapid tool movements
tips.body: Clearance plane: all retract and infeed movements are executed via the clearance plane.

tips.title: Use boundary curves to limit machining area
tips.body: Boundary curve: Use boundaries to manually limit the area to be machined.

tips.title: Use milling surfaces to define machining area
tips.body: Milling surfaces: Use milling surfaces to define the area to be machined.

tips.title: Set tool reference for traverse area
tips.body: Tool reference: During some machining cycle a definition of the traverse area in dependence on the boundary curve is possible.

tips.title: Define offset value for pre-machining with rough boundary
tips.body: Positive values enlarge boundaries, negative values reduce them; an offset of 0 corresponds to O n mode.

tips.title: Choose tool axis leave boundary method
tips.body: Past (3): Tool axis leaves the boundary; Contact: Milling path ends when no longer in contact with surface.

tips.title: Enable smooth overlap for high surface quality
tips.body: Use smooth overlap function when machining with manual boundaries to achieve better surface quality.

tips.title: Define stop surfaces to prevent tool contact
tips.body: Use stop surfaces to define areas of the CAD model where no machining takes place.

tips.title: Trim toolpaths using stock or milling area
tips.body: Enable Trim to stock or Trim to milling area to use the defined stock or milling area for trimming toolpaths.

tips.title: Project boundaries in desired direction
tips.body: Define projection direction for manual boundaries to limit machining area or delimit difficult-to-access areas.

tips.title: Select milling surface mode for ball mills
tips.body: Standard: Use Soft bounding option; Extension: Use Milling surface extension option to protect model edges.

tips.title: Define extension surfaces for milling surface mode
tips.body: Automatic: Extension surfaces are generated by default; Manual: Define surfaces manually.

tips.title: Use soft bounding for ball mills
tips.body: Enables machining to continue when tool exceeds surface by a factor based on tool radius (0.02-0.2).

tips.title: Define bounding surfaces manually
tips.body: Select surfaces that connect tangentially or continue vertically downward as bounding surfaces.

tips.title: Define stop surfaces for no machining area
tips.body: Use stop surfaces to prevent tool contact with specific areas of the CAD model.

tips.title: Use 'All other surfaces' for automatic stop surfaces
tips.body: Automatically defines all workpiece surfaces not used for milling as stop surfaces.

tips.title: Set offset for stop surfaces
tips.body: Extends the area excluded from machining by a specified value in X, Y, and Z directions.

tips.title: Trim toolpaths to stock
tips.body: Enables using the stock to trim toolpaths with a defined offset value.

tips.title: Trim toolpaths to milling area
tips.body: Enables using the milling area to trim toolpaths.

tips.title: Use approach and retract macros
tips.body: Available macros include vertical, circular, tangential, and ramp options.

tips.title: Execute macros normal to surfaces
tips.body: Approach and retract macros are executed in the direction of surface normals.

tips.title: Enable return macro for horizontal stepover
tips.body: Executes a return macro between milling paths via the clearance plane or distance.

tips.title: Specify model for current job
tips.body: Define the milling area required for the current job.

tips.title: Define additional surfaces for safety
tips.body: Temporary safety surfaces to avoid unnecessary rapid travel movements.

tips.title: Set clearance value for tool check
tips.body: Clearance value added for each tool component (retained minimum distance to model).

tips.title: Define stop/clip tolerance for collision-free movement
tips.body: Tolerance value specifies the retract (and approach) point for collision-free movement.

tips.title: Calculate length for tool extension
tips.body: Options include extending or reducing the tool reach based on defined parameters.

tips.title: Extend tool reach for collision avoidance
tips.body: Calculates a larger tool reach based on the defined tool reach, ignoring maximum possible reach.

tips.title: Reduce tool reach for actual possibility
tips.body: Calculates the shortest possible collision-free tool reach based on defined parameters.

tips.title: Display calculated tool length
tips.body: Select the tool in the browser and choose the Usage function on the shortcut menu after creating the toolpath file(s).

tips.title: Handle unresolvable collisions in 5X machining
tips.body: Change tool orientation or calculate the tool length to resolve collisions.

tips.title: Collision avoidance options
tips.body: Stop, Clip, or Collision avoidance strategies are available for machining strategies.

tips.title: 3D path compensation for ball mill tools
tips.body: Available with a specially adjusted postprocessor, allowing different NC programs to machine the model using a smaller or larger tool.

tips.title: High precision surface mode
tips.body: Enable for highest accuracy (Machining tolerance ≤0.005), calculation based on real surfaces of the model.

tips.title: Z-Level Shape Finishing
tips.body: Optionally replace z-level cuts with cuts parallel to any shape.

tips.title: Supported tool types
tips.body: Includes ball mill, end mill, bullnose end mill, lollipop, general barrel tool, tangent barrel tool, conical barrel tool, indexable cutters.

tips.title: Machining options for Shape offset mode
tips.body: Edge only or Side walls, with specified boundary curves or milling surfaces.

tips.title: Machining priority options
tips.body: Axial sorting, Prefer spiral, Allow zigzag.

tips.title: Cutting mode definitions
tips.body: Climb milling and Conventional milling relate to clockwise rotating tools.

tips.title: Shape offset mode parameters
tips.body: Bottom parameter must be >= 0 for machining below the bottom surfaces.

tips.title: Z Level machining parameters
tips.body: Surface and depth are defined automatically by hyperMILL based on the model.

tips.title: Bottom to top milling option
tips.body: Activate when machining is to take place from bottom to top.

tips.title: Allowance and vertical infeed mode options
tips.body: Constant stepdown, Scallop height, Minimum vertical stepdown, Maximal vertical stepdown.

tips.title: Set plane level detection
tips.body: Off: Keep vertical stepdown for each roughing level irrespective of workpiece surface. Automatic: Insert intermediate steps if defined value is greater than distance between two surfaces. Only planar faces: Machine only plane-parallel surfaces inside the boundary.

tips.title: Define clearance plane
tips.body: Clearance plane: Plane for rapid tool movements. Specify in absolute dimensions by right-clicking on the icon and selecting a point.

tips.title: Set retract mode
tips.body: Define Z level where horizontal infeed movements are executed. Clearance plane and distance apply in the direction of the current frame's Z axis.

tips.title: Use boundary curves for machining area
tips.body: Closed curves like Polylines, Splines, Circles can be used as boundaries. Z position of boundaries is not considered.

tips.title: Use milling surfaces for machining area
tips.body: Milling surfaces calculate a boundary automatically based on the cycle used.

tips.title: Define boundary options for machining cycles
tips.body: Options include To, On, Offset, Past. Each option has specific behavior regarding tool contact with boundaries.

tips.title: Use smooth overlap for boundary machining
tips.body: Activate Use smooth overlap function to achieve high surface quality at the end of machining area.

tips.title: Define boundary projection direction
tips.body: Select geometric element and define X, Y, Z direction manually or reverse direction using icons.

tips.title: Use manual boundaries for milling surfaces
tips.body: Define boundaries on milling surfaces to control tool edge behavior and ensure proper surface normals.

tips.title: Enable smooth overlap for boundary machining
tips.body: Activate the Use smooth overlap function to achieve high surface quality at the end of machining areas.

tips.title: Configure soft bounding for ball mills
tips.body: Set blending factor between 0.02 and 0.2 to ensure full machining of milling surfaces.

tips.title: Define stop surfaces for milling operations
tips.body: Use stop surfaces to exclude areas from machining and ensure tool safety.

tips.title: Enable macros for additional movements
tips.body: Define macros for smooth approach and retract movements to improve tool behavior.

tips.title: Configure macro mode for automatic or manual movements
tips.body: Choose between Smooth, Length, Side clearance/Axial clearance, and Max. axial lift for macros.

tips.title: Use ramp retract macro for controlled tool retraction
tips.body: Ramp length (1), Ramp angle (2), and Ramp height (3) can be adjusted.

tips.title: Enable horizontal stepover with Return macro
tips.body: Executes between milling paths via clearance plane or distance.

tips.title: Set feedrate for approach and retract macros
tips.body: Default = Feedrate XY.

tips.title: Use start points for individual control of machining start
tips.body: Select the closest point on the toolpath and add a user-defined macro.

tips.title: Enable stock model for collision checks
tips.body: Automatically enabled if Trim to Stock option is used.

tips.title: Tool check ensures collision avoidance with CAD model
tips.body: Check all components defined for the tool based on existing material.

tips.title: Set stop/clip tolerance for collision-free movement
tips.body: Specifies the retract and approach point for collision-free movement.

tips.title: Calculate tool length for collision avoidance
tips.body:
Extend: Calculates larger tool reach based on defined tool reach.
Reduce: Calculates shortest collision-free tool reach.

tips.title: Control G1 length for planar surfaces
tips.body: Greater distances are subdivided into a corresponding number of G1 movements.

tips.title: Set minimum G0 distance for toolpath traversal
tips.body: Distance between two machining areas that can be traversed without tool contact.

tips.title: Stop tool execution at stop markers in toolpath
tips.body: Tool stops at any stop marker encountered.

tips.title: Enable high precision surface mode for critical applications
tips.body: Calculation based on real surfaces of the model, not faceted geometry.

tips.title: Use Iso machining for exact surface machining
tips.body: Milling paths follow the course of Iso lines (U, V) for optimal adaptation to surface flow.

tips.title: Select supported tool types for machining
tips.body: Ball mill, end mill, bullnose end mill, lollipop, indexable cutters with round inserts.

tips.title: Define Iso orientation for machining paths
tips.body: Milling paths follow the course of ISO lines (U, V) of selected surfaces.

tips.title: Define Global orientation for machining paths
tips.body: Milling paths run crossways or parallel to the longest boundary curve of selected surfaces.

tips.title: Set machining direction for Iso orientation strategy
tips.body: First milling path runs in the positive direction of selected Iso parameter.

tips.title: Set machining direction for Global orientation strategy
tips.body: Machining direction is either crossway or flow, parallel to longest boundary curve.

tips.title: Define infeed mode for horizontal stepover
tips.body: Direction of horizontal stepover between milling paths.

tips.title: Use Zigzag direct for machining with changing cutting mode
tips.body: Machining direction changes between positive and negative directions.

tips.title: Use Zigzag smooth for machining with changing cutting mode
tips.body: Machining direction changes smoothly between positive and negative directions.

tips.title: Define direction of milling paths
tips.body: The direction of all milling paths is defined by the direction of the ISO line.

tips.title: Enable spiral option for continuous toolpath
tips.body: If the P refer spiral option is enabled, machining takes place in a continuous toolpath with a spiral-shaped vertical stepdown.

tips.title: Group toolpaths for ISO orientation strategy
tips.body: Available only for the I SO orientation strategy.

tips.title: Define start and end profiles for global orientation strategy
tips.body: Available only for the G lobal orientation strategy. Define the start (1) and end (2) of the machining using two profiles.

tips.title: Set infeed distance for toolpaths
tips.body: 3D stepover: The cutting of the infeed distance between the individual milling paths always takes place on the surface.

tips.title: Define type of cut for toolpaths
tips.body: Type of cut: When the type of cut is set to A scending, upward cutting takes place. Application: Roughing close to the surface to remove material (allowance) from a preceding roughing operation.

tips.title: Set retract mode for toolpaths
tips.body: The retract mode defines the Z level where the system executes horizontal infeed movements.

tips.title: Define clearance distance for toolpaths
tips.body: Clearance distance (1): all retract and infeed movements are executed via the clearance distance.

tips.title: Define clearance plane for toolpaths
tips.body: Clearance plane (1): Plane for rapid tool movements.

tips.title: Use boundaries to limit machining area
tips.body: Boundaries: Use boundaries to manually limit the area to be machined.

tips.title: Define tool reference for machining
tips.body: Tool reference: On (1): Machining of the defined area until the tool axis is on top of the boundary.

tips.title: Use stop surfaces to define non-machining areas
tips.body: Stop surfaces: Use stop surfaces to define the area of the CAD model on which no machining takes place.

tips.title: Define approach and retract macros
tips.body: Approach macro / Retract macro: Additional movements during infeed on the first milling path of a job.

tips.title: Define return macros for alternating orientation
tips.body: Return macros (2): Return macros are possible during machining with alternating orientation.

tips.title: Enable tool check for collision detection
tips.body: Check on: Always enable this option to ensure the tool is checked for collisions.

tips.title: Use Extend option for tool length calculation
tips.body: Extend (1): If there is a tool extension, holder or spindle collision, hyperMILL will calculate a larger tool reach based on the tool reach defined for the tool.

tips.title: Use Clip option for collision-free toolpaths
tips.body: Clip: The toolpath is fully calculated. Only the collision-free areas of the toolpaths are output.

tips.title: Reverse machining direction for mirrored contours
tips.body: In the case of mirrored contours, the contour direction is always automatically reversed.

tips.title: Set clearance plane for rapid tool movements
tips.body: Clearance plane (1): Plane for rapid tool movements. Specification in absolute dimensions.

tips.title: Define clearance distance for infeed movements
tips.body: Clearance distance (2): Distance to the current toolpath to be milled.

tips.title: Use Stop surfaces to define no machining area
tips.body: Stop surfaces: Use stop surfaces to define the area of the CAD model on which no machining takes place.

tips.title: Enable Trim to stock for toolpath trimming
tips.body: Trim to stock: Enable to use the stock to trim the toolpaths.

tips.title: Define approach and retract macros for tool movements
tips.body: The following tool movements are offered for approach and retract behaviour: Perpendicular, Circular, Tangential, Ramp.

tips.title: Set feedrate macros for approach and retract movements
tips.body: Define the feedrate for approach and retract macros with Feedrate lead in and Retract.

tips.title: Use Macros normal to surfaces for approach and retract
tips.body: The approach and retract macros are executed in the direction of the surface normals.

tips.title: Adjust stop/clip tolerance for collision-free movement
tips.body: Set the 'Stop/Clip tolerance' value to specify the retract and approach point for collision-free movement.

tips.title: Use 'Reduce' option for tool length calculation
tips.body: Select the 'Reduce' option to calculate the shortest possible collision-free tool reach based on the defined tool reach.

tips.title: Enable 'Check tolerance' for model geometry check
tips.body: Set the 'Check tolerance' parameter to avoid unnecessary retraction movements at vertical walls, using a factor of the tool radius.

tips.title: Use 'Compensated centre path' for repointed tools
tips.body: Enable the 'Compensated centre path' function if repointed tools are to be used, ensuring collision-free machining.

tips.title: Select cutter types for vertical machining
tips.body: Choose from ball mill, end mill, and bullnose end mill for vertical machining operations.

tips.title: Define vertical machining area using model geometry
tips.body: Set the 'Vertical machining area' using default values for Top and Bottom of the component or manually specify values on the model.

tips.title: Set material height for toolpaths
tips.body: Use the 'Material height' parameter to specify the height of the material to be removed during machining.

tips.title: Trim toolpaths on stock using 'Trim to stock' option
tips.body: Select the 'Trim to stock' option to trim the toolpaths on the stock during vertical machining operations.

tips.title: Set vertical infeed mode for stepdown
tips.body: Configure the 'Vertical stepdown' to determine the number of machining levels during vertical infeed operations.

tips.title: Define finish allowance for final pass
tips.body: Set the 'Finish allowance' to specify the material removed during a final finish pass in vertical machining operations.

tips.title: Set horizontal machining area and border behavior
tips.body: Use BOUNDARY option to set one or more boundaries limiting the machining area. Use PLANE SELECTION to define plane surfaces to be machined.

tips.title: Define clearance distance and plane
tips.body: Clearance distance: Distance to the toolpath, above which infeed is rapid, below which it's at Z feedrate. Clearance plane: Plane for rapid tool movements.

tips.title: Use plunge macros for stock removal
tips.body: Helical: Use to remove stock of 3D pockets. Helix radius, angle, and number of tool revolutions depend on vertical stepdown and lead angle.

tips.title: Avoid unnecessary rapid travel movements
tips.body: Trim to stock: Enable to use the stock to trim toolpaths, avoiding unnecessary rapid travel movements.

tips.title: Check tool for collisions
tips.body: Tool check ensures components defined for the tool are protected from collision with the CAD model based on existing material.

tips.title: Calculate tool length
tips.body: Use 'Reduce' option for collision-free reach or 'Extend' for larger reach based on available tools.

tips.title: Set machining tolerance
tips.body: Enter required accuracy for toolpath generation.

tips.title: Define clearance feedrate
tips.body: Set speed for movements without material removal between G1 commands.

tips.title: Use bullnose end mill
tips.body: Consider corner radius for infeed distance to avoid material ridges.

tips.title: Select machining direction
tips.body: Base selection on main extension of machining area, considering machine tool capabilities.

tips.title: Set stock allowance
tips.body: Define horizontal and vertical allowances for machining, considering corner radius.

tips.title: Enable Max. step height for continuous allowance on sloped walls
tips.body: Max. step height must be less than or equal to Vertical stepdown. Example calculation: (Vertical stepdown / Max. step height) rounded up.

tips.title: Use automatic plane level detection for planar surfaces
tips.body: Automatically inserts intermediate steps if the defined vertical stepdown value is greater than the distance between two surfaces of the workpiece.

tips.title: Set smallest infeed to 0.25 mm/0.01 inch
tips.body: Smallest infeed value is 0.25 mm (0.01 inch). This can be adjusted based on tool size and material.

tips.title: Use Optimised - complete for roughing
tips.body: First rough with constant feedrate, then automatically generated pass to remove rest material on plane-parallel surfaces.

tips.title: Enable Minimal stock removal for collision avoidance
tips.body: Minimal stock removal value should be calculated as stock tolerance + machining tolerance + required minimum removal.

tips.title: Enable Finish pass all levels for thorough machining
tips.body: Ensures tool moves along entire defined contour, even if no material is cleared.

tips.title: Set clearance distance for collision-free infeed
tips.body: Clearance distance is added to starting and end positions of infeed movements in rapid.

tips.title: Use clearance plane for rapid tool movements
tips.body: Clearance plane must be placed at a sufficient distance above the surface of the workpiece.

tips.title: Enable Opening cut for initial roughing
tips.body: Opening cut should be made if required.

tips.title: Enable Zigzag for alternating orientation/cutting mode
tips.body: Zigzag mode is required if machining with alternating orientation/cutting mode is needed.

tips.title: High Performance Mode strategies
tips.body: Two strategies are available: Opening cut and Side mill only.

tips.title: Opening cut parameters
tips.body: Adapt the vertical stepdown and feedrate to the machining situation.

tips.title: Side mill only parameters
tips.body: No full cut behavior is allowed.

tips.title: Reposition safety
tips.body: Axial movement (in the Z direction) away from the plane currently being machined. Default value: Clearance distance * 0.1.

tips.title: Dense area stepover
tips.body: Lateral infeed for trochoidal movements in narrow, inaccessible areas.

tips.title: Plunge feedrate
tips.body: Minimum feedrate for plunge movement in closed pockets that cannot be accessed from the outside.

tips.title: Opening cut feedrate
tips.body: Maximum feedrate for the opening cut.

tips.title: Min. feedrate for opening cut
tips.body: Enable to specify the minimum feedrate for the opening cut.

tips.title: Entry feedrate factor for side entry
tips.body: Regulates the lateral approach from outside and is referenced to the feedrate XY of the tool.

tips.title: Entry feedrate factor for plunge entry
tips.body: Affects the helical or ramp plunge into the material from above.

tips.title: Zigzag feedrate factor
tips.body: Reduces the conventional milling feedrate by a specified factor.

tips.title: High Performance Mode limitations
tips.body: Standard functions in the Arbitrary Stock Roughing cycle are not available or limited.

tips.title: Tool reference options
tips.body: Options available: T o, On, Past.

tips.title: Plunge points requirements
tips.body: A corresponding hole must be present in the stock for the plunge point used.

tips.title: Residual stock management
tips.body: Limit machining area to grooves.

tips.title: Use axial plunge for infeed without stock removal
tips.body: Axial plunge macro is used when the user-defined plunge point is outside of stock or boundary.

tips.title: Helical plunge for removing stock in 3D pockets
tips.body: Helical plunge macro is used to remove the stock of 3D pockets with a helix radius and lead angle.

tips.title: Ramp plunge for continuous ramping-in movement
tips.body: Ramp plunge macro generates a continuous ramping-in movement without reversing direction for closed pockets.

tips.title: Control spindle RPM and dwell time for plunge macro
tips.body: Spindle speed changes occur during the dwell time before and after the plunge macro.

tips.title: Use additional surfaces for collision checks
tips.body: Define temporary safety surfaces to avoid unnecessary rapid travel movements during machining.

tips.title: Define stock for machining
tips.body: Generate a stock model for subsequent machining tasks and check the result of the machining.

tips.title: Undercut trimming to avoid unnecessary empty paths
tips.body: Avoidance of unnecessary empty paths in undercut areas during multi-axis stock indexing.

tips.title: Tool check to avoid collisions
tips.body: Ensure that all components defined for the tool are protected from collision with the CAD model.

tips.title: Calculate tool length with options
tips.body: Extend option calculates a larger tool reach based on the tool reach defined for the tool, while Reduce option calculates the shortest possible collision-free tool reach.

tips.title: Handle unresolvable collisions
tips.body: Options include Stop, Clip, and Collision avoidance for machining strategies when unresolvable collisions occur.

tips.title: Output circular arcs as G2/G3 commands
tips.body: Circular arcs in the level are output in the NC program as G2 or G3 commands if enabled.

tips.title: Define minimum pocket size for machining
tips.body: Define the minimum size for pockets that can be machined with the specific tool, default is 3.5 * tool radius.

tips.title: Stop toolpath execution at stop marker
tips.body: A stop marker in the toolpath causes the tool to stop.

tips.title: Define minimum G0 distance for toolpath
tips.body: Defines the maximum distance between two machining surfaces without tool contact close to the surface with machining feedrate.

tips.title: Bridging minor surface gaps
tips.body: Use Z Level Finishing for bridging minor surface gaps (gap < tool radius).

tips.title: Traversing of small inside boundaries
tips.body: Use Z Level Finishing for traversing of small inside boundaries.

tips.title: Protecting machine ramps against overstressing
tips.body: Eliminate minor rapid movements to protect machine ramps against overstressing.

tips.title: Supported tool types for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Supported tools: Ball mill, end mill, bullnose end mill, lollipop, indexable cutter with round inserts, T-Slot Cutter, Woodruff Cutter.

tips.title: Exceptions for Z Level Finishing in Scallop height mode
tips.body: Z Level Finishing in Scallop height mode does not support end mills.

tips.title: Tapered tools in Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Tapered tools may be used, but the conical shape is not used in collision avoidance calculations.

tips.title: Lollipop mills for undercut machining
tips.body: Lollipop mills can be used for undercut machining.

tips.title: Machining sequence for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Plane (1): Machining is carried out level by level. Pocket (2): Contour pockets or islands are machined in sequence.

tips.title: Prefer spiral for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Machining is performed in one continuous toolpath with a complete or approximate spiral-shaped vertical stepdown.

tips.title: Ramp connect strategy for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Level-by-level machining with ramp-shaped, filleted stepdown between the levels.

tips.title: Connect factor for ramp connect
tips.body: Ramp length = Tool diameter x Factor.

tips.title: Zigzag connect strategy for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Machining with alternating orientation.

tips.title: Infeed mode for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Rapid: Rapid retract movement to clearance distance/plane. Direct: Shortest path at feedrate. Smooth: Filleted transition between toolpaths.

tips.title: Cutting modes for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Climb milling: Clockwise rotating tools. Conventional milling: Counterclockwise rotating tools.

tips.title: Fillet interior corners for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Smooth filleting of internal milling paths at the corners of contour pockets or islands.

tips.title: Slope mode for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: During Z Level Finishing, machining of surfaces with a small slope angle leads to unsatisfactory quality.

tips.title: Slope dependent machining for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Only possible with bullnose end mills and ball mills, cannot be used in conjunction with a spiral strategy.

tips.title: Smooth overlap for slope dependent machining
tips.body: Enable if you want the toolpaths of flat and steep areas to overlap.

tips.title: Bottom to top milling for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Activate when machining is to take place from bottom to top.

tips.title: Machining area definition
tips.body: The vertical machining area is defined by the values for Top and Bottom of the component.

tips.title: Allowance for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Remaining material on the workpiece, calculated in direction of surface normals.

tips.title: Additional allowance XY for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Enables machining with different stock allowances for the bottom and side walls of the machining area.

tips.title: Vertical infeed mode for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Constant stepdown: Fixed infeed depth. Scallop height: Pre-defined scallop height not exceeded.

tips.title: Scallop height value for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Enter the required scallop height.

tips.title: Minimum vertical stepdown for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Limits the distance between the milling paths.

tips.title: Maximal vertical stepdown for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Upper limit for the vertical distance of the toolpaths.

tips.title: Plane level detection for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Off: Defined vertical stepdown kept for each roughing level. Automatic: Intermediate steps for planar surfaces.

tips.title: Path compensation for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: May be used for path compensation.

tips.title: Retract mode for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: Z level where horizontal infeed movements are executed.

tips.title: Clearance distance for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: All retract and infeed movements are executed via the clearance distance.

tips.title: Clearance plane for Z Level Finishing
tips.body: All retract and infeed movements are executed via the clearance plane.

tips.title: Set clearance distance for infeed control
tips.body: Distance to the current toolpath; above, rapid Z infeed (A); below, Z feedrate (B).

tips.title: Use boundaries to limit machining area manually
tips.body: Closed curves like Polylines, Splines, Circles can be used; Z position not considered.

tips.title: Define plunge point for infeed onto next finishing level
tips.body: Manually set XY coordinates or let hyperMILL automatically find the deepest point.

tips.title: Enable plunge on first machining plane only
tips.body: Use stop surfaces to define areas where no machining occurs.

tips.title: Use macros for approach and retract movements
tips.body: Define smooth circular motion or manual perpendicular, circular, tangential approaches/retractions.

tips.title: Set maximum axial lift
tips.body: Maximum length of the lifting movement in the axial direction.

tips.title: Choose approach and retract behavior
tips.body: Available options: Perpendicular, Circular, Tangential, Ramp (only as an approach macro). These movements are only carried out if they do not result in a collision.

tips.title: Define feedrate for macros
tips.body: Feedrate for approach and retract macros. If no feedrate is defined, the macros are run with the Feedrate XY from the Tool dialogue page.

tips.title: Configure macro simultaneous for specific cycles
tips.body: Available for the cycles 5X Z Level Finishing, 5X Swarf Cutting 1 Curve and 5X Shape Offset Finishing.

tips.title: Specify the model for the current job
tips.body: Specify the milling area required for the current job.

tips.title: Enable stock model for machining
tips.body: Enable stock to use a stock model. Enabled automatically if the Trim to Stock option is used.

tips.title: Adjust postprocessor for 3D path compensation
tips.body: The function is available only with a specially adjusted postprocessor.

tips.title: Handle unresolvable collisions in machining strategies
tips.body: Stop: Toolpath calculation stops when a collision occurs. Clip: Only collision-free areas of the toolpaths are output.

tips.title: Define minimum G0 distance for rapid traversal
tips.body: Set minimum distance between machining areas, e.g., 1 mm.

tips.title: Use stop markers in toolpath for safety
tips.body: Insert stop markers to cause tool to halt at specific points.

tips.title: Enable 3D path compensation for ball mill tools
tips.body: Adjust toolpath to compensate for different tool sizes, e.g., max. 10% of cutter diameter.

tips.title: Select cutter types for machining
tips.body: Choose from ball mill, end mill, or bullnose end mill.

tips.title: Configure slope-dependent machining strategy
tips.body: Set parameters for slope angle, e.g., between 10 and 80 degrees.

tips.title: Enable smooth overlap for slope-dependent machining
tips.body: Activate overlap to ensure high surface quality in transition areas.

tips.title: Set cutting mode for toolpath generation
tips.body: Choose between climb milling and conventional milling.

tips.title: Define machining area manually if needed
tips.body: Set top and bottom Z values for manual limiting in the Z direction.

tips.title: Specify vertical stepdown for machining planes
tips.body: Set number of machining planes, e.g., 10 levels.

tips.title: Set allowance for remaining material
tips.body: Define remaining material on the workpiece, e.g., 0.1 mm.

tips.title: Configure horizontal stepover for infeed movement
tips.body: Set infeed length as a factor of tool diameter, e.g., J:ae/T:Dia.

tips.title: Define clearance distance for retract movements
tips.body: Set distance to the current toolpath, e.g., 10 mm.

tips.title: Use plane level detection for planar surfaces
tips.body: Automatically insert intermediate steps if vertical stepdown exceeds surface distance.

tips.title: Exclude surfaces from machining
tips.body: Define areas to exclude from machining, e.g., dome surface with slope angle of 60°.

tips.title: Define approach and retract macros for Complete Finishing
tips.body: hyperMILL automatically determines the optimal approach or retract movement.

tips.title: Set smooth approach and retract movements
tips.body: Smooth: The approach or retract movement is performed smoothly in a circular motion.

tips.title: Define length for approach and retract movements
tips.body: Length: Defines the length of the approach or retract movement.

tips.title: Set lateral/axial clearance for approach and retract movements
tips.body: Lateral / Axial clearance: Clearance in the axial or X/Y direction that can be travelled without a collision.

tips.title: Define maximum axial lift for approach and retract movements
tips.body: Max. axial lift: Maximum lifting movement in the axial direction.

tips.title: Use collision avoidance for machining strategies
tips.body: Collision avoidance: With this option, the tool is side-stepped to avoid collision.

tips.title: Set maximum G1 length for planar surfaces
tips.body: Maximum G1 length: maximum length of the G1 movements on planar surfaces.

tips.title: Use stop marker for toolpath execution
tips.body: Stop before execution: A stop marker in the toolpath causes the tool to stop.

tips.title: Use minimum distance G0 for bridging minor surface gaps
tips.body: Use min. distance G0: Bridging minor surface gaps (gap < tool radius!).

tips.title: Use Equidistant Infeed Strategy
tips.body: Machining with constant infeed for smoother surface finish.

tips.title: Select Multiple Profiles for Machining
tips.body: Choose multiple closed profiles that are not nested for complex machining tasks.

tips.title: Offset Profiles for 3D Machining
tips.body: Offset selected profile curves with a defined value (positive/negative) for precise control.

tips.title: Use Flow Infeed Strategy for HSC Machining
tips.body: Suitable infeed strategy for high-speed cutting (HSC) operations.

tips.title: Define Reverse Direction for Guide Curves
tips.body: Reverse the direction of guide curves if they are in an opposed direction.

tips.title: Equal Synchronisation for Guide Curves
tips.body: Divide guide curves into the same number of segments and link start/end points.

tips.title: Use Zigzag Direct Infeed Mode for Steep Areas
tips.body: Change machining direction after each profile to avoid damage in steep areas.

tips.title: Set Clearance Distance for Retract Movements
tips.body: Define the Z level where horizontal infeed movements are executed.

tips.title: Use Clearance Plane for Rapid Movements
tips.body: Plane for rapid tool movements, defined in absolute dimensions.

tips.title: Define Additional Allowance XY for Machining
tips.body: Enable machining with different stock allowances for the bottom and side walls of the machining area.

tips.title: Use Boundary for Manual Limiting of Machining Area
tips.body: Manually limit the area to be machined using boundaries.

tips.title: Enable Smooth Overlap at Boundary for Surface Quality
tips.body: Achieve a high surface quality at the edges of the machining area by enabling smooth overlap.

tips.title: Define Approach Macro for Horizontal Stepover
tips.body: Additional tool movements only take place when this can be done without causing a collision.

tips.title: Define Return Macro for Horizontal Stepover
tips.body: Horizontal stepover is executed between the milling paths via the clearance plane or clearance distance.

tips.title: Use Reduce option for collision-free tool reach calculation
tips.body: The Reduce option calculates the shortest possible collision-free tool reach based on the defined tool reach of the tool.

tips.title: Display calculated tool length for reused tools
tips.body: After creating the toolpath file(s), select the tool in the browser and choose the Usage function on the shortcut menu to display the calculated tool length.

tips.title: Use Stop before execution for toolpath control
tips.body: A stop marker in the toolpath causes the tool to stop.

tips.title: Enable Use min. distance G0 for minor surface gaps
tips.body: Bridging minor surface gaps (gap < tool radius!) and traversing of small inside boundaries.

tips.title: Enable High precision surface mode for high accuracy
tips.body: Calculate the toolpath based on the real surfaces of the model, not just faceted geometry.

tips.title: Use Bullnose end mills for deep material areas
tips.body: With bullnose endmills, even deepest material areas can be machined more easily and tidily.

tips.title: Cavity width must not exceed tool diameter for tidy machining
tips.body: To ensure tidy machining without any remaining material ridges, the cavity width must not exceed 1.8 x tool diameter.

tips.title: Select bullnose end mill as reference tool type for entire part mode
tips.body: If you select bullnose end mill as a reference tool type, machining is only possible in entire part mode!

tips.title: Define cavity depth for machining mode switch
tips.body: Available for the Cavities and open areas and Only cavities strategies. Defines the depth from which the machining mode switches to cavity mode.

tips.title: Use Complete Machining for cavities and open areas
tips.body: Cavities and open areas are machined. Slope-dependent machining is automatically activated.

tips.title: Use Open areas without cavities for machining open areas
tips.body: Only open areas are machined.

tips.title: Define slope angle for slope-dependent machining
tips.body: The delimitation of steep and flat areas is determined by defining a slope angle.

tips.title: Set clearance distance for infeed movements
tips.body: All retract and infeed movements are executed via the clearance distance, which is added to starting and end positions of an infeed movement.

tips.title: Adjust clearance plane for rapid tool movements
tips.body: Define the clearance plane by right-clicking on the icon and selecting a point to ensure traversing movements are not checked with regard to collisions.

tips.title: Enable Roughing mode for complete or limited rest material machining
tips.body: Activate the Roughing mode to machine rest material areas completely or limit them to cavities.

tips.title: Define additional allowances for roughing mode
tips.body: In addition to the usual allowance, define an Allowance in Z direction and an additional XY allowance.

tips.title: Project boundary in any desired direction
tips.body: Define the projection direction for the selected boundary to limit the machining area or delimit difficult-to-access areas.

tips.title: Use stop surfaces to define areas not to be machined
tips.body: Select stop surfaces to define areas that should not be machined.

tips.title: Enable multiple allowances for different groups in the milling area
tips.body: If the milling area contains groups with different allowances, these allowances are taken into account during machining if the function is enabled.

tips.title: Define temporary safety surfaces for collision checks
tips.body: Surfaces in the machining area that need to be known to perform a correct collision check.

tips.title: Define multiple allowances in machining
tips.body: Group 0: allowance = 0 (A), Group 1: allowance = -1.5 (B). Prevent tool generation below the bottom plane.

tips.title: Display calculated tool length for reuse
tips.body: Select the tool in the browser and choose the Usage function to display the calculated tool length.

tips.title: Set resolution value for rest material area calculation
tips.body: Values between 0.25 and 0.5 recommended, depending on the parallelism of flat areas.

tips.title: Activate parallel sorting for path segments
tips.body: Sorts parallel to each other if paths need to be shortened due to boundaries or tool holder collisions.

tips.title: Use Ball mill and Bullnose end mill tools
tips.body: Supported for machining operations.

tips.title: Select reference tool for rest material area calculation
tips.body: Reference tool diameter must be greater than machining tool diameter.

tips.title: Define machining strategy for corner rest machining
tips.body: Options include All, Corner and rest material, Restmaterial and bottom, etc.

tips.title: Set rest material height for Z Level Machining
tips.body: Default value is the diameter of the reference tool.

tips.title: Define minimum clearance angle for parallel machining
tips.body: Default value is 5°, larger values reduce the parallel machining area.

tips.title: Set fillet radius for toolpath rounding
tips.body: Rounds abrupt changes in direction within the cutting toolpaths.

tips.title: Select bottom surfaces for machining
tips.body: Available for specific machining strategies like Restmaterial and bottom, Restmaterial only.

tips.title: Define machining parameters
tips.body: Set parameters such as machining tolerance, maximum G1 length, and clearance distance.

tips.title: Use parallel strategy infeed
tips.body: Set horizontal stepover for machining with a parallel strategy in the upper area of the vertical corner.

tips.title: Set vertical stepdown for corner rest infeed
tips.body: Define the vertical stepdown for machining with a Z Level strategy in the lower area of the vertical corner.

tips.title: Define side stepover for bottom side step
tips.body: Set the lateral infeed for the area of the bottom surfaces.

tips.title: Set retract mode for Z level
tips.body: Define the Z level where the system executes horizontal infeed movements.

tips.title: Set machining tolerance for accuracy
tips.body: Enter the required machining tolerance to define calculation accuracy.

tips.title: Define maximum G1 length for planar surfaces
tips.body: Set the maximum length of G1 movements on planar surfaces in the NC program.

tips.title: Define machining mode for swarf or plunge
tips.body: Select between swarf or plunge machining methods.

tips.title: Set tool position on contour or beside it
tips.body: Define the cutter's position relative to the contour during machining.

tips.title: Define allowance for X and Y directions
tips.body: Set the remaining allowance in the X and Y direction for machining to the right or left of the contour.

tips.title: Set vertical stepdown for infeed
tips.body: Define the Z infeed to the next machining pass, adjusting automatically based on last infeed and machining depth.

tips.title: Set infeed mode to oneway or zigzag
tips.body: Choose between always machining in the same orientation (oneway) or alternating orientation (zigzag).

tips.title: Enable Z-smoothing for contour quality
tips.body: Smooth the toolpath if insufficient contour quality is detected.

tips.title: Enable Z-constant for reference job machining strategy
tips.body: Constantly machine remaining rest material areas from a preceding roughing operation.

tips.title: Set horizontal infeed mode to fixed step
tips.body: Retain the value defined under Lateral infeed area for lateral infeed, adjusting automatically based on total infeed.

tips.title: Adjust lateral infeed area for consistency
tips.body: Automatically adjust lateral infeed to ensure all infeeds are equal, considering total infeed.

tips.title: Enable spring path for complete contour machining
tips.body: Use spring path to machine entire defined contour, even if no more material will be cleared.

tips.title: Smooth filleting of internal milling paths
tips.body: Fillet interior corners for pockets or islands using smooth rounding.

tips.title: Adjust interior corner feedrate for tool protection
tips.body: Reduce feedrate at interior corners to protect the tool, defined in tool database as a technology parameter.

tips.title: Define clearance distance for collision-free movements
tips.body: Set clearance distance to ensure collision-free linear infeed movements during retract and infeed.

tips.title: Set retract mode for horizontal infeed movements
tips.body: Define the Z level where system executes horizontal infeed movements, valid for all machining directions.

tips.title: Define plunge machining parameters
tips.body: Set parameters for plunge machining method, including tool position and allowance.

tips.title: Define side clearance for collision avoidance
tips.body: Set minimum distance from the surface of the machined part to avoid collisions.

tips.title: Define stop surfaces for boundary machining
tips.body: Limit machining using stop surfaces with an offset to enlarge or reduce the boundary.

tips.title: Define macros normal to surfaces for approach and retract
tips.body: Execute approach and retract macros in the direction of surface normals.

tips.title: Set check tolerance for model geometry
tips.body: Enter the permissible violation of the model geometry, factor of the tool radius.

tips.title: Stop before execution
tips.body: A stop marker in the toolpath causes the tool to stop.

tips.title: Rework Machining
tips.body: Milling of pre-calculated toolpaths that were generated in an earlier reference job using the Clip option but were not machined to avoid collisions.

tips.title: Tool types for Rework Machining
tips.body: The following cutter types can be used: ball mill, end mill and bullnose end mill.

tips.title: Collision avoidance with tapered tools
tips.body: When using tapered tools, collision avoidance is possible by taking into account the conical shape of the tool in the toolpath calculation.

tips.title: Rework area parameters
tips.body: Parameters include Rework area, Toolpath, Collision path, Connect smooth, Allowance, Retract mode, Clearance distance (1), and Clearance plane (2).

tips.title: Retract mode definition
tips.body: The retract mode defines the Z level where the system executes horizontal infeed movements.

tips.title: Clearance plane and distance
tips.body: Clearance plane (1) is for rapid tool movements, while Clearance distance (2) defines the distance to the current toolpath.

tips.title: Boundary usage
tips.body: Boundaries manually limit the area to be machined, and offset can extend or reduce this area.

tips.title: Stop surfaces definition
tips.body: Stop surfaces define areas of the CAD model on which no machining takes place.

tips.title: Trim to stock feature
tips.body: Enable to use the stock to trim the toolpaths, considering a defined Offset.

tips.title: Macros for approach and retract movements
tips.body: Additional movements to vertical infeed and retract movements define a gentle approach and retract behavior.

tips.title: Automatic macros parameters
tips.body: Parameters include Length, Side clearance/Axial clearance, Max. axial lift, and Feedrate macros.

tips.title: Manual approach and retract methods
tips.body: The tool can be approached or retracted in a Perpendicular, Circular, or Tangential manner.

tips.title: Plunge macro strategies
tips.body: Various plunge strategies are available for infeed movement to the next machining level.

tips.title: Axial plunge macro
tips.body: Executes a linear movement in Z direction for infeed without stock removal.

tips.title: Helical plunge macro
tips.body: Used to remove the stock of 3D pockets with a helix radius and lead angle.

tips.title: Ramp plunge macro
tips.body: Proceeds along the first milling path with a defined enter lead angle.

tips.title: Define approach and retract macros for milling paths
tips.body: Available macros include Axial, Perpendicular, Circular, Tangential, and Ramp.

tips.title: Use macros simultaneously in specific cycles
tips.body: Macro simultaneous is available for 5X Z Level Finishing, 5X Swarf Cutting 1 Curve, and 5X Shape Offset Finishing.

tips.title: Set up tool check for collision detection
tips.body: Enable the tool check to ensure components are protected from collisions with the CAD model.

tips.title: Adjust tool reach for collisions
tips.body: Use the Extend or Reduce options to calculate collision-free tool reaches based on defined parameters.

tips.title: Control G1 length on planar surfaces
tips.body: Subdivide large distances into smaller G1 movements to avoid strong accelerations.

tips.title: Max. compensation value
tips.body: Should be no more than 10% of the cutter diameter.

tips.title: Activate parallel sorting for Rework Machining
tips.body: Combine interrupted paths into groups to generate parallel paths for better efficiency.

tips.title: Rib/Groove Machining cycle
tips.body: Used for roughing and finishing ribs and grooves, machining side surfaces and floor areas in separate jobs.

tips.title: Use reference tool for machining areas
tips.body: The reference tool is used to calculate the areas to be machined.

tips.title: Bullnose end mills and ball mills for machining
tips.body: Can use bullnose end mills, ball mills, including tapered tools.

tips.title: Machining mode - Steep only
tips.body: Only steep areas are machined, defined by the S slope angle.

tips.title: Machining mode - Bottom only
tips.body: Only flat areas are machined.

tips.title: Machining sequence - Plane
tips.body: Carries out machining level by level, executing approach and retract macros in each Z-level.

tips.title: Machining sequence - Pocket
tips.body: Stock removal with infeed optimisation, machining cavities in sequence.

tips.title: Cutting mode - Climb milling
tips.body: Clockwise rotating tools for climb milling, anticlockwise for conventional milling.

tips.title: Toolpath fillets in contour-parallel machining
tips.body: Rounding toolpaths in the plane with specified radius for horizontal infeed and corners.

tips.title: Machining area - Vertical machining area
tips.body: Defined by the Top and Bottom values of the component.

tips.title: Manual top/bottom for machining area
tips.body: Manually limit the Z direction in the machining area by clicking on the model icons.

tips.title: Vertical stepdown for stock allowance
tips.body: Determines the number of machining planes.

tips.title: Allowance for stock removal
tips.body: Remaining material on the workpiece, calculated in direction of surface normals.

tips.title: Z constant machining for negative stock allowances
tips.body: Allowance only applies in X and Y direction, not Z direction.

tips.title: Additional allowance XY for stock removal
tips.body: Enables machining with different stock allowances for the bottom and side walls of the machining area.

tips.title: Horizontal stepover for infeed
tips.body: Infeed in the machining plane (XY plane) specified as length dimension or factor of tool diameter.

tips.title: Minimal stock removal for machining
tips.body: Minimum material quantity that must be removed.

tips.title: Retract mode for machining
tips.body: Defines the Z level where horizontal infeed movements are executed.

tips.title: Clearance distance for retract and infeed movements
tips.body: Distance to the current toolpath, above which infeed is rapid, below which it's at Z feedrate.

tips.title: Clearance plane for retract and infeed movements
tips.body: Plane for rapid tool movements, defined by clicking on the icon.

tips.title: Bottom machining for bottom only mode
tips.body: Height of the floor area to be machined, vertical stepdown.

tips.title: Avoid shank at boundary for tapered tools
tips.body: Enable to ensure tool shank does not touch the boundary, available for tapered tools with a defined stock model.

tips.title: Define traverse area based on boundary curve
tips.body: Options include: To (ends when tool shank contacts boundary), On (moves tool axis to top of boundary), Offset (adjusts boundary size), Past (leaves boundary and ends machining)

tips.title: Use plunge macro for infeed movement
tips.body: Options include: Axial (linear Z movement), Helical (3D pocket removal, helix radius and angle), Ramp (ramping-in along first milling path)

tips.title: Define stock for machining tasks
tips.body: Generate stock model and check results for subsequent machining

tips.title: Avoid unnecessary empty paths in undercut areas
tips.body: Undercut trimming to prevent empty paths during multi-axis stock indexing

tips.title: Handle unresolvable collisions during machining
tips.body: Options include: Stop (toolpath calculation stops), Clip (collision-free areas output), Collision avoidance (side-stepping tool)

tips.title: Adjust stepover for narrow areas
tips.body: Increase accuracy in narrow areas by adjusting stepover factor.

tips.title: Use stop markers to halt toolpath execution
tips.body: Insert stop markers in the toolpath to cause the tool to stop at specified locations.

tips.title: Set maximum distance for gap traversal
tips.body: Define the maximum distance between two machining surfaces without tool contact.

tips.title: Use Form Pocket for free-form floor finishing
tips.body: Automatically determine pocket contour based on a reference plane and calculate paths parallel to the contour.

tips.title: Select appropriate cutter types for machining
tips.body: Use ball mill, end mill, or bullnose end mill based on the job requirements.

tips.title: Define machining sequence for plane milling
tips.body: Carry out machining level by level, executing approach and retract macros in each Z-level.

tips.title: Optimize infeed for pocket machining
tips.body: Use infeed optimization to remove stock efficiently during pocket machining.

tips.title: Set fillet radius for toolpaths
tips.body: Rounded abrupt changes in direction within the cutting toolpaths with specified radius.

tips.title: Define machining area using Top and Depth
tips.body: Set the vertical machining area by specifying the top and depth parameters.

tips.title: Set reference plane for pocket machining
tips.body: Define a cutting plane through the pockets to be machined and generate paths on this plane.

tips.title: Adjust stepover for horizontal machining
tips.body: Specify the infeed in the XY plane as a factor of the tool diameter or length dimension.

tips.title: Set retract mode for horizontal movements
tips.body: Define the Z level where system executes horizontal infeed movements.

tips.title: Define clearance distance for tool movements
tips.body: Distance to the current toolpath where infeed takes place as rapid or at Z feedrate.

tips.title: Set clearance plane for rapid movements
tips.body: Plane for rapid tool movements, defined in absolute dimensions.

tips.title: Define boundaries for machining area
tips.body: Several independent boundaries are permitted that do not overlap or nest inside each other.

tips.title: Set plunge point for pocket machining
tips.body: Define an infeed point for machining a single pocket, entry of X and Y coordinates.

tips.title: Use macros for retract and plunge movements
tips.body: Define macros for vertical, perpendicular, and circular retraction movements.

tips.title: Use macros for helical plunge movements
tips.body: Define macros for removing stock of 3D pockets using helical infeed movement.

tips.title: Define additional surfaces for safety checks
tips.body: Temporary safety surfaces to avoid unnecessary rapid travel movements.

tips.title: Perform tool check for collision avoidance
tips.body: Ensure all components defined for the tool are protected from collisions with the CAD model.

tips.title: Enable tool collision check
tips.body: Always enable this option to ensure the tool is checked for collisions during machining.

tips.title: Use Reduce option for tool length calculation
tips.body: This option calculates the shortest collision-free tool reach based on the defined tool reach.

tips.title: Stop tool before execution
tips.body: A stop marker in the toolpath causes the tool to stop before execution.

tips.title: Ignore small pockets during machining
tips.body: Enable this function to protect the tool from cutting over centre.

tips.title: Automatically recognize grooves for Pencil Milling
tips.body: This cycle generates toolpaths running parallel to the contour for each groove.

tips.title: Select appropriate cutter types for Pencil Milling
tips.body: Use ball mill, end mill, bullnose end mill, or lollipop tools.

tips.title: Use reference tool for Pencil Milling
tips.body: The reference tool is of the same type as the machining tool and should be 20% larger in diameter.

tips.title: Define frame orientation for Pencil Milling
tips.body: The frame orientation is valid for computing the grooves as well as for machining.

tips.title: Select cutting mode for machining
tips.body: Options include C limb milling, Conventional milling.

tips.title: Set machining mode for different areas
tips.body: Options include Off, Tilt angle, Flat areas, Steep only, All areas.

tips.title: Define infeed parameters for machining
tips.body: Set machining depth, vertical stepdown, and allowance.

tips.title: Define machining area for vertical machining
tips.body: Set the Top and Bottom values to define the vertical machining area.

tips.title: Set manual top and bottom values for Z direction
tips.body: Click on icons to specify values directly on the model; manually defined values are not associative.

tips.title: Set clearance distance for infeed and retract movements
tips.body: Clearance distance is added to starting and end positions of infeed movements.

tips.title: Limit maximum G1 length on planar surfaces
tips.body: Greater distances are subdivided into a corresponding number of G1 movements.

tips.title: Set maximum angle increment for tool inclination
tips.body: Restricts permissible change of the tool inclination between two points.

formulas.name: Actual step height calculation
formulas.expression: (Vertical stepdown / Max. step height) rounded up
